title: The Interplay Between Physical Activity, Protein Consumption, and Sleep Quality in Muscle Protein Synthesis
text: BACKGROUND: Muscle protein synthesis declines with age and inactivity. METHODS: This randomized trial enrolled 42 adults and combined resistance training, adequate protein consumption, and at least 7 hours of nightly sleep. RESULTS: The combined intervention produced a 15 percent improvement in muscle protein synthesis relative to control. CONCLUSIONS: Sleep quality is an independent contributor to synthesis rates.
